_meta.owner: skills/generate-figma-screen (HAND-MAINTAINED — this file is NOT generated)
_meta.purpose: Render-time capability limits that the Figma libraries do not expose as data. The static plan validation and the runtime read them through build-registry-maps.cjs.
_meta.whyASeparateFile: components.json is FULLY regenerated by build-from-kb.cjs from the Knowledge Database, and the hand-curated fields it preserves are an explicit allowlist (labelNodePath, note, forbiddenFallback, deprecated sets, hand-written axes). Anything outside that list is dropped SILENTLY on the next regeneration — a limit stored there would simply vanish and the check that depends on it would stop firing without an error. A skill-owned file cannot be dropped by a generator that does not write it.
_meta.contract: Add a constraint here when the rule is about what the RENDERER must respect, not about what the component IS. Component identity (keys, variant axes, properties) belongs in the Knowledge Database and reaches us through components.json.

Navigation.appliesTo: Header `navItems` — the number of top-level entries the desktop Navigation LIST can show.
Navigation.verifiedAgainst: DB UX DS v3 - Core Components v4.13.0, desktop Navigation LIST (Beta). The runtime additionally counts the real nav item nodes on the instance and stays the ultimate truth; this value is what the STATIC check can know before a render.
Navigation.raiseWhen: Only together with the library's Navigation LIST "Amount" variant offering a higher step. A lost nav item makes a page unreachable while the screen still looks fine, so this must never be raised to 'make the plan fit'.
